The test image shows a sugarcane leaf with alternating light and dark green bands/stripes running longitudinally along the leaf lamina. This mosaic-like pattern with broad light green/yellowish areas points toward a mosaic virus disease.

Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference for Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus shows a fine mottled/speckled yellow-green pattern throughout the leaf. The test image, by contrast, shows broader bands of light green alternating with darker green — large light areas without numerous small streaks.

This actually aligns with the Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus description: "large yellow or light green areas without small streaks" (distinguishing from SCSMV which shows numerous small streaks). The banded light/dark green pattern fits the mosaic virus description well.
